verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs describe Scheduling Links that share your availability so others can book time across one or many calendars. Bookers see your true availability across multiple calendars, free events show as bookable, and lower-priority events can be offered up for more important meetings. Together these cover sharing a link that books from live availability without email back-and-forth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the booking-link flow (all evidence is vendor documentation).
